name: hempton-podcast
label: James Hempton podcast clips
format: 9:16 shorts cut from a multicam podcast: cuts + captions only, no b-roll
approved: 2026-10-18, clip 01 of the James Galligan episode

job_inputs.clips: clients/<client>/<episode>/clips.tsv  (id, slug, segments mm:ss-mm:ss{first words|last words}+..., speaker, why; why starting 'James asks first' / 'Galligan asks first (n)' = the opening question is the hook)
job_inputs.hooks: clients/<client>/<episode>/hooks.tsv  (id, hook): one curiosity text hook per clip
job_inputs.music: clients/<client>/<episode>/music.tsv  (id, file, start, gain_db): one bed per clip, measured

selection.mix: mostly the guest, plus clips James leads where the guest asks him or adds to it (about 6 in 30)
selection.open_on_question: open on the FULL question, every word of it, with enough context to stand alone (Eoin 18 Oct: 'never cut the hook question short again'). Long questions wrap onto two lines per row, never trimmed.
never: tangents that hurt the client (vices etc.)
naming people the client shouldn't be tied to

cut.transcribe: openai-whisper medium.en word_timestamps, NO initial_prompt (it skips the first ~30s)
cut.anchors: every segment cut on text anchors, whole words only
cut.post_hook_flash: if the answer opens on a <30-frame piece of another camera, the question shot is held under the answer's first words (no flash)

framing.face_lock: Fusion Transform Center via XYPath (absolute X), keyed every 3rd frame at COMPN_RenderStart + f
framing.face_track: MediaPipe BlazeFace every frame, gaussian sigma 2 frames

intro_zoom.curve: Eoin's Smooth Zoom out (Perception edit): bezier P0(0,1.278) P1(2,1.114) P2(17.6,1) P3(35,1)

hook.split: <=3 words 1 row (Blur Up), <=5 two rows (Line Left + Blur Up), else three rows: first up to 3, middle, last 2 big
hook.set_text_on: StyledTextFollower 'Text' (setting it on the Text+ kills the animation)
hook.long_rows: a row too wide for one line breaks into two balanced lines

text_hook.position: directly under the speaker's chin, question rows stacked beneath (his head fills the top of this crop)
text_hook.duration: ends on the cut when the clip opens on a question, else 3.0s

captions.animation: blur in + rise, sharp within ~4 frames (the stock base.comp never goes solid)
captions.drop: standalone interjections from the other mic (Yeah. / Right.), um/uh
captions.position: just under the lowest chin in the framing (y ~1020 of 1920), nearer the centre (Eoin 18 Oct)

pool: A Good Man with a Broken Heart.mp3
Echo Sax End (Original) by Caleb Arredondo.mp3
Ty's Music - As Time Flies - Special Version.mp3
Moments x Where Roses Bloom (Voice Memo).mp3
Aaron Hibell - i feel lost [official audio].mp3
music.match: soft beds on reflective/emotional clips, cleaner driving beds on business clips; never the same track back to back

resolve.project: build into the OPEN project, one timeline per clip named '<id> <slug>'
safety: re-select the clip's timeline before every append (Resolve appends to whatever is open)
switch away from a timeline before deleting it
never touch Resolve from a second process while a batch builds
